column3: Likewise, wives, be subject to your own husbands, so that even if some disobey the word, they may be won without a word through the conduct of their wives,
when they observe your pure conduct in fear.
Let your adornment not be the outward one of braiding hair and putting on gold ornaments or wearing garments,
but the hidden person of the heart, in the imperishable quality of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious before God.
For in this way formerly the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being subject to their own husbands,
as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. You have become her children if you do good and do not fear any terror.
Likewise, husbands, live with your wives according to knowledge, showing honor to the woman as the weaker vessel and as co-heirs of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered.
Finally, all of you be of one mind, sympathetic, loving one another as brothers and sisters, tenderhearted, humble-minded,
not repaying evil for evil or insult for insult, but on the contrary blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
For “the one who wants to love life and see good days must keep the tongue from evil and the lips from speaking deceit.
Let that person turn away from evil and do good; let that person seek peace and pursue it.
For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears toward their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
And who is the one who will harm you if you become zealous for what is good?
But even if you should suffer for righteousness, you are blessed. Do not fear their fear, and do not be troubled,
but sanctify Christ as Lord in your hearts, always ready to give a defense to everyone who asks you for a reason concerning the hope within you,
yet with gentleness and fear, having a good conscience, so that in the matter in which you are slandered, those who mistreat your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame.
For it is better, if the will of God should will it, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, so that he might bring you to God, put to death in flesh but made alive in spirit,
in which also he went and proclaimed to the spirits in prison,
who formerly disobeyed when the patience of God waited in the days of Noah while the ark was being prepared, in which a few—that is, eight souls—were brought safely through water.
Corresponding to this, baptism now saves you—not removal of dirt from the flesh, but an appeal to God for a good conscience—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, with angels and authorities and powers subjected to him.
